breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains both the RAS and LES sections in the turbulenceProperties and repeats the flawed instruction about capturing 'both Reynolds-Averaged and Large-Eddy Simulation characteristics simultaneously.' The ground truth removes the LES section entirely and uses only RAS with k-Epsilon. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
